profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft | AI Engineering, Distributed Systems & Reliability
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft with experience in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI engineering.

My work spans large-scale backend platforms, distributed workflow orchestration, and production reliability, with a recent focus on AI-powered systems, knowledge graphs, LLM evaluation, and observability.

I'm passionate about building scalable, reliable, and production-ready software systems that bridge traditional engineering and emerging AI technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build and improve large-scale distributed systems and cloud-based backend services, focusing on scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
• Contribute to AI-powered engineering platforms integrating knowledge graphs, LLMs, and agent-based workflows.
• Improve AI system reliability through evaluation frameworks, data quality validation, and regression detection.
• Enhance observability, telemetry, and production diagnostics across distributed services and AI workflows.
• Modernize commerce infrastructure and distributed workflow orchestration to improve operational efficiency and service resilience.
positions.insights: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Distributed Systems and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: IMS solution for Samsung Android handsets: RCS, Entitlement, and so on.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Improved the UI and the functionality of videoconference web application
• Added features to the current video-chat and whiteboard Flex applications using Flash Builder
• Redesigning the former Android mobile application and expanding it to other platforms

positions.title: Undergraduate TA for CS Courses
positions.description:
• Providing innovative and progressive ideas in weekly staff meetings for advancing the Data Structures course
• Teaching students General Computer Science Concepts and Data Structures through C++ and Java languages

projects.title: GeoAlarm
projects.description:
• A stop notifier android application for CUMTD
• Allows the user to select a destination bus stop and set the alarm to ring off based on some selected criteria  
• Performed as Software Engineering II course project  – usage of Java and ADT
• Published on Google Play

projects.title: CUTransit
projects.description:
• Champaign-Urbana MTD (Mass Transit District) android application  
• Provides all kinds of useful functionalities helping users when traveling within the Champaign-Urbana area.
• Published on Google Play
